{{Top|Leg}}
The "'''Spirva Run'''" was the nickname give to the act of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] items from [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|Galladinium's Datalog]] to rioters in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]]. [[Cynabar's InfoNet/Legends|Cynabar's InfoNet]] reported that noted smugglers such as [[Tru'eb Cholakk]], [[Bettle]] and [[Jaxa]], and [[To'iir]] and [[Liadden]] were cashing in on the Spirva riots, though the latter pair had been caught after running several loads of [[gladiator walker]]s into the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="SWAJ14">{{JournalCite|14|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
